svg.aria-label: Qwen3-14B on one device each, memory drawn to scale. L40S 48 GB holds 2 conversations and reads the weights in 34 ms. A100 80 GB holds 7, 14.5 ms. H200 141 GB holds 18, 6.2 ms. B200 180 GB holds 24, 3.7 ms. Rubin 288 GB holds 42, 1.3 ms. One wafer, 44 GB, holds 2 and reads the weights in about 1.4 microseconds.
